item.title: Chinese-linked hackers compromise ConnectWise, target hundreds in global attack, Microsoft says
item.description: A Chinese-linked hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign that targeted hundreds of organizations globally, Microsoft said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Chinese-linked hacking group used an AI-driven penetration testing tool to compromise IT services firm ConnectWise as part of a campaign that targeted hundreds of organizations globally, Microsoft said on Wednesday. ConnectWise did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Microsoft's conclusions, although a statement posted to the company's website on October 16 said it was "investigating recent attempts of unauthorized access associated with the ConnectWise Cloud Backup environment." The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing regularly denies conducting or condoning cyber-enabled data theft. The hackers, which Microsoft tracks as Storm-0940, used an open-source penetration testing framework called ARTEX to carry out the campaign, Microsoft said. There are multiple tools used to conduct penetration testing, a form of legitimate testing of the security of networks or services. ARTEX allows users to use any AI model to automate a variety of penetration testing tasks and can be configured to run autonomous tasks including reconnaissance and data exfiltration, Microsoft said. The attack targeted organizations across a wide variety of sectors, including aerospace, defense, automotive, chemicals, energy, financial services, government, legal, manufacturing, media, military, semiconductor, software, technology, think tanks and nonprofits, Microsoft said. While the majority of the targeting was not successful, Microsoft said, Storm-0940 achieved privileged cloud persistence — or high-level access that could continue even after cleanup efforts — at many organizations in a brief time.

item.title: Walmart launches tools for AI agents to shop for customers
item.description: Walmart on Wednesday introduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers, as the retailer seeks to position itself in the growing use of AI-powered assistants in online commerce.
item.dc:creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
item.content:encoded: Walmart (WMT.O) on Wednesday introduced new tools that will allow artificial intelligence agents to shop and complete transactions for customers, as the retailer seeks to position itself in the growing use of AI-powered assistants in online commerce. The move underscores Walmart's push into AI-enabled shopping, and strikes a contrast with Amazon (AMZN.O) , which has sought to limit third-party AI shopping agents' access to its platform. Here are the details: The retailer said it will roll out "Agent Profiles" next month, enabling shoppers to authorize individual AI agents, track their purchases separately and set spending limit or require approval for each transaction. Walmart said customers would be able to monitor purchases made by AI agents separately from their own orders and revoke agent access at any time. The company also launched the "Walmart Agent Gateway," a platform that allows AI assistants such as OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Meta's Muse to connect directly with Walmart and Sam's Club systems to search products and complete purchases. Walmart said customers would remain in control of purchases, while AI agents would be barred from accessing payment card data and could be blocked for violating company rules The company said the tools will be available to all Walmart account holders and will not require a Walmart+ membership.

item.title: Former Chiefs, Falcons DE Allen Bailey dies at age 37
item.description: Former Kansas City Chiefs defensive end Allen Bailey has died at the age of 37.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Kansas City Chiefs defensive end Allen Bailey has died at the age of 37. "Our hearts go out to his family," Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said to begin his news conference on Wednesday. "Prayers are with them. Way too young, obviously. One of my favorite players. Great kid. Just sorry to see that happened to him." Bailey was found dead on Tuesday in his Florida home, with his family telling TMZ that they believe he died from natural causes. No official cause of death had been released as of Wednesday afternoon. "Allen Bailey was an excellent teammate, generous man, and kind soul," the Chiefs posted on social media on Wednesday. "We're deeply saddened to hear of his passing, and our thoughts and prayers are with his family and friends." Kansas City selected Bailey in the third round of the 2011 NFL Draft out of Miami. He totaled 248 career tackles, 22 sacks, 40 tackles for loss, 40 quarterback hits, four forced fumbles and seven fumble recoveries (one returned for a touchdown) in 133 regular-season games (70 starts) for the Chiefs (2011-18) and Atlanta Falcons (2019-20). He also played in six playoff games (five starts) and had 10 tackles, two sacks and two forced fumbles. "Rest in peace, Allen Bailey," the Falcons posted on social media, using the folded hands/prayer emoji. "We send our deepest condolences to his family and friends." Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes said Wednesday that Bailey was the first person he saw when he entered the locker room after getting drafted in 2017. Seeing the burly and athletic Bailey, listed at 6-foot-3 and 288 pounds, made Mahomes realize he wasn't in college anymore, calling it "surreal." "Obviously, it's terrible to hear the news," said Mahomes, Bailey's teammate for two seasons. "A great teammate -- he's one of those glue guys on the team. He makes plays. He's not necessarily a superstar, but the guy that kind of makes everything go. We're praying for his family. (As) teammates, we've talked and we know that we're going to do whatever we can to support those guys." A native of Sapelo Island, Ga., Bailey played 50 games for the Miami Hurricanes from 2007-10 and made 107 tackles, 19 sacks and 31 tackles for loss with two forced fumbles. He was a two-time All-Atlantic Coast Conference selection. "It's terrible, especially with all the good he (did)," Reid said of Bailey's death. "He's got a family and that's a sad deal. I know his father passed away young, too. It makes you sick when it happens to somebody that young." --Field Level Media

item.title: Vance defends Ramaswamy's explosive attack ad in Ohio governor race
item.description: US Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday defended an explosive attack ad by Republican Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign against his Democratic rival in the Ohio governor’s race.
item.dc:creator: Helen Coster
item.content:encoded: US Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday defended an explosive attack ad by Republican Vivek Ramaswamy’s campaign against his Democratic rival in the Ohio governor’s race. The ad features Democrat Amy Acton’s estranged mother, Donna Arthur, disputing Acton’s account of a childhood she says involved a period of homelessness and sexual abuse. Arthur, whom Acton says she has not seen since 1978, urges Ohioans not to vote for her daughter. Acton has said she was sexually abused by her stepfather when she was 12. Her mother stayed with the stepfather, who was charged with rape but fled the state and was never tried. He died in 2004. Acton's brother has supported her account. The ad initially appeared on social media on Tuesday without identifying its source, but Ramaswamy’s campaign later said it was behind the spot and was spending $4 million to promote it. The ad, which has been widely condemned, underscores the incivility of the run-up to the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"November 3 midterm elections"] and could backfire on Ramaswamy and other Republican candidates in Ohio, which has moved to the right during the Trump years, analysts said. Vance, campaigning with Ramaswamy and Republican US Senator Jon Husted on Wednesday, brushed aside the blowback. “Vivek Ramaswamy had the audacity to run a TV commercial which calls it out like it is and calls Amy Acton a liar,” said Vance, who rose to fame on his own story of childhood neglect in Ohio. “And my message, ladies and gentlemen, is very simple. Whatever you think about any of the TV advertisements, focus on the substance and focus on the facts.” 'DISGUSTING ATTACK' Acton's brother, Philip Stearns, said in a statement that Ramaswamy's ad was a "desperate, disgusting attack." Acton campaign spokesperson Addie Bullock said Ramaswamy's decision to promote the ad was "both despicable and entirely predictable." As the backlash built on Tuesday, Ramaswamy's campaign spokesperson Connie Luck issued a statement saying: "We don't know what happened between Amy and her mother ... but we know that Amy Acton is a serial fabulist." Opinion polls show Acton with a narrow lead over Ramaswamy, and the scandal could help cement her position as the favorite in the race, analysts said. “It was campaign malpractice,” said David Cohen, a political science professor at the University of Akron. Cohen said it could also mean trouble for Husted, who said in a statement that he would "not have run that ad" and who polls show trailing Democrat Sherrod Brown in a [USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:"race"] that will help determine control of the US Senate. Among Republicans, Cohen predicted, "I think this will either encourage some people to switch parties, or more likely, you're going to have a lot of people staying home" on Election Day.

item.title: Café arábica atinge maior nível em quase 6 semanas
item.description: Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE subiram nesta quarta-feira, sendo negociados perto da maior cotação em seis semanas, em meio a baixos estoques nos países de destino e a um aumento lento nos volumes dos armazéns certificados.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE subiram nesta quarta-feira, sendo negociados perto da maior cotação em seis semanas, em meio a baixos estoques nos países de destino e a um aumento lento nos volumes dos armazéns certificados. O cacau também registrou alta, enquanto o açúcar apresentou ligeira queda. CAFÉ Os futuros de café arábica fecharam em alta de 4,85 centavos, ou 1,6%, a US$3,1615 por libra-peso, após atingirem US$3,1820 na sessão anterior, sua maior cotação desde 9 de setembro. Os estoques de café verde no Japão e na Europa, dois dos maiores mercados para a bebida, diminuíram em agosto em relação ao ano passado, de acordo com dados de entidades do setor. Os corretores esperam que os estoques nos países de destino aumentem gradualmente à medida que o fluxo da safra recorde de café no Brasil melhore. Os estoques de café arábica nos armazéns da ICE continuam limitados a 239.748 sacas, com um pequeno volume aguardando recomendação. "Nenhum lote significativo chegou à bolsa na semana passada, o que o mercado interpretou como um sinal de alta", afirmou Ilya Byzov, trader quantitativo da Sucafina, em uma nota. Byzov disse que o mercado está acompanhando de perto a eleição presidencial no Brasil neste domingo, que pode ter implicações para a moeda local e para as vendas dos cafeicultores. O café robusta caiu 1,8%, para US$3.364 por tonelada métrica. AÇÚCAR O preço do açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,07 centavos, ou 0,3%, a 20,45 centavos por libra-peso, após atingir na semana passada uma máxima de 19 meses, de 21,29. Foi a quarta sessão consecutiva de perdas para o açúcar, embora pequenas. Com os fundos mantendo uma posição comprada quase recorde, o mercado está sujeito a uma correção, afirmaram os corretores. O déficit de oferta no mercado global de açúcar, ou a diferença entre produção e demanda, foi projetado na terça-feira para crescer para 6,28 milhões de toneladas, 3 milhões de toneladas a mais do que a estimativa anterior, de acordo com a analista de mercado Green Pool Commodities. O preço do açúcar branco caiu 0,6%, para US$ 543,70 a tonelada. CACAU O preço do cacau em Londres fechou em alta de £24, ou 0,5%, a £4.469 por tonelada. O presidente de Gana, John Dramani Mahama, disse na quarta-feira que o país tem como meta processar pelo menos 50% dos grãos de cacau localmente, com apenas 50% da produção anual disponível para exportação. "Isso deve trazer parte do processamento para o país e gerar empregos para a população", disse ele. O cacau de Nova York subiu 0,7%, para US$ 5.843 por tonelada. (Reportagem de Sybille de La Hamaide e Marcelo Teixeira)

item.title: Federación de Costa Rica confirma a ex capitán Bryan Ruiz como DT de selección rumbo a Mundial 2030
item.description: La Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) confirmó el miércoles al histórico ex capitán de la selección mayor, Bryan Ruiz, como director técnico de la selección centroamericana para encabezar el proceso hacia la Copa del Mundo del 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) confirmó el miércoles al histórico ex capitán de la selección mayor, Bryan Ruiz, como director técnico de la selección centroamericana para encabezar el proceso hacia la Copa del Mundo del 2030. Ruiz, de 41 años, asume su primera experiencia como entrenador de la selección después de dirigirla de manera interina en dos triunfos el 1 y el 4 de octubre en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf, tras el fracaso del argentino Fernando "Bocha" Batista que provocó su despido. "Como futbolista, Bryan Ruiz fue durante años uno de los grandes referentes de la Selección Nacional y llevó con orgullo la cinta de capitán de la Tricolor. Ahora, desde el banquillo, pondrá al servicio de Costa Rica toda esa experiencia, liderazgo y conocimiento del fútbol nacional e internacional y de la selección", informó la FCRF en un comunicado. El nuevo seleccionador viene de dirigir en las ligas menores del club local Alajuelense. En septiembre dirigió al primer equipo en dos juegos de Copa Centroamericana antes de ser llamado como emergente a la selección. Dos victorias contra Nicaragua y Haití permitieron a los "ticos" mantener la categoría y opciones de jugar la fase preliminar para ir a la Copa Oro de 2027, aunque quedaron fuera de la Liga de Naciones. Satisfechos por un mejor desempeño, los seleccionados costarricenses alabaron las virtudes de Ruiz después de esos juegos y pidieron que continúe, al igual que los dirigentes para intentar volver a un Mundial, pues Costa Rica se ausentó en 2026 al fracasar en la clasificación con el técnico mexicano Miguel "Piojo" Herrera. Ruiz asume como técnico de la selección cuatro años después de retirarse como jugador, y después de brillar como centrocampista ofensivo en el Alajuelense, en el Twente de Países Bajos y en el Fulham de Inglaterra, además de participar en los mundiales de Brasil 2014, Rusia 2018 y Qatar 2022. El nuevo director técnico estará acompañado por los ex seleccionados Wilmer López y Christian Bolaños como asistentes, además del ex portero Wardy Alfaro. Ruiz debutará como técnico oficial en partidos amistosos ante las selecciones de Ecuador el 13 de noviembre en Quito, y tres días después ante Argentina en Córdoba.

item.title: An affinity for warm climes has helped crocs thrive for eons
item.description: Crocodilians — today's crocodiles, alligators, caimans and gharials and their many extinct relatives — have been a roaring success since debuting more than 240 million years ago. And new research identifies one important factor in their success — stubbornly keeping to warm climates throughout their history.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: Crocodilians — today's crocodiles, alligators, caimans and gharials and their many extinct relatives — have been a roaring success since debuting more than 240 million years ago. And new research identifies one important factor in their success — stubbornly keeping to warm climates throughout their history. In fact, the researchers said, this trait may help explain why crocs as a group survived the [USN:L1N3JU1FQ TEXT:"asteroid strike"] 66 million years ago that doomed [USN:L1N3EN28W TEXT:"the dinosaurs"], along with certain physiological characteristics that make them one tough bunch of reptiles. The crocodilian evolutionary lineage, called Pseudosuchia, arose during the Triassic Period in the aftermath of Earth's worst mass extinction event at the end of the Permian, appearing on the scene millions of years before the first dinosaurs and mammals. The researchers tracked the geographic range for crocs during their entire history, guided by an evolutionary tree of more than 400 extinct and living species. They used data from more than 7,000 fossils and geographic records of modern crocs such as the alligators of Florida, saltwater crocodiles of Australia, gharials of India, caimans of Brazil and more. They combined this information with 52 global palaeoclimate reconstructions to determine the climatic conditions under which crocs lived over time. While other groups such as dinosaurs and [USN:L1N45T0VO TEXT:"mammals"] conquered a variety of climates, the study showed that crocs consistently kept to warm climes. "Rather than continually adapting to new climatic conditions, they largely tracked suitable environments as these shifted geographically, expanding towards the poles during warmer periods and retreating towards the equator during cooler ones," said University College London vertebrate paleontologist Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, lead author of the research published in the journal Science Advances . For example, during an exceptionally warm moment in Earth's history around 50 million years ago, Chiarenza said, crocs inhabited high-latitude regions of North America, Europe and even Antarctica. "One of the most striking patterns is the repeated expansion and contraction of suitable habitat in response to global temperature changes," Chiarenza said. While living crocs are primarily semiaquatic ambush predators, their extinct relatives included a broad diversity of forms, University College London paleontologist and study co-author Philip Mannion said. "They have occupied almost every conceivable ecological role," Chiarenza said. There were fully land-dwelling apex predators like 30-foot-long (9-meter-long) Fasolasuchus, pug-snouted herbivores like Simosuchus, armored plant-eaters like Aetosaurus, mollusk-eaters like Kuttanacaiman, filter-feeders like Mourasuchus and ocean-going types like Metriorhynchus. During the age of dinosaurs, there also were semiaquatic crocs like Deinosuchus up to 40 feet (12 meters) long that may have rivaled Tyrannosaurus in mass. "Modern crocodilians are only the surviving remnants of a once extraordinarily diverse evolutionary group," Chiarenza said. DISASTER FROM ABOVE The asteroid strike at a site called Chicxulub off the coast of Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula at the end of the Cretaceous unleashed a [USN:L1N3BU2U6 TEXT:"global environmental cataclysm"]. Three-quarters of Earth's species [USN:L1N32W1OO TEXT:"including the dinosaurs"], aside from their bird descendants, vanished. The crocs survived. "The Chicxulub impact caused a dramatic reduction in incoming sunlight, producing an impact winter and widespread environmental disruption. However, our climate simulations suggest that this cooling did not affect the availability of suitable climatic conditions equally for all groups," Chiarenza said. "Under all but the most extreme impact scenario we tested, tropical and subtropical regions retained climatic conditions suitable" for the crocs, Chiarenza said. This suggests that the longstanding association of crocs with warm and low-latitude environments may have placed some surviving populations in geographic refuges near the equator and in the subtropics where climatic conditions remained within their tolerances, Chiarenza said. For dinosaurs, there was a collapse of suitable habitat under these impact conditions. Crocs also possess physiological traits beneficial for times of environmental stress. They can enter states of dormancy to cope with harsh conditions — aestivation to survive extreme heat or drought, and brumation to withstand extreme cold. Crocs today, for instance, may dig burrows or encase themselves in hardened mud during severe droughts, slowing their heartbeat and breathing. "Following the Chicxulub impact, when sunlight was dramatically reduced and terrestrial primary productivity collapsed, the ability to reduce energy expenditure and survive periods of limited food availability could have been extremely advantageous," Chiarenza said. Crocs also are cold-blooded, while recent research points to at least some dinosaurs including [USN:L1N4560E4 TEXT:"Tyrannosaurus as warm-blooded"]. Baseline metabolic requirements for cold-blooded animals are much lower than for comparably sized warm-blooded animals. "That can become a significant advantage when food becomes scarce. Crocodilians can survive extended periods without feeding," Chiarenza said. "But even if an animal can survive prolonged starvation, it still needs environmental conditions that remain within its physiological limits."

item.title: Diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos entra en carrera por la jefatura de la ONU
item.description: Lana Nusseibeh, una diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, ingresó el miércoles a la carrera por la secretaría general de la ONU, lo que supone la incorporación de una destacada candidata de Oriente Medio a una contienda en la que ha resultado difícil alcanzar consenso.
item.dc:creator: Maha Dahan
item.content:encoded: Lana Nusseibeh, una diplomática de alto rango de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, ingresó el miércoles a la carrera por la secretaría general de la ONU, lo que supone la incorporación de una destacada candidata de Oriente Medio a una contienda en la que ha resultado difícil alcanzar consenso. Nusseibeh, que fue embajadora de los EAU ante la ONU durante más de una década, declaró a Reuters que trataría de restablecer el papel del organismo como mediador diplomático en un momento de crecientes crisis globales. "Está claro que hoy necesitamos un secretario general que pueda renovar su compromiso con el futuro del multilateralismo y con el futuro de las Naciones Unidas como mediador, en lugar de como mero espectador de las crisis mundiales", afirmó poco antes de hacer pública su candidatura. Nusseibeh, ministra de Estado de Asuntos Exteriores de los EAU, se ha sumado tarde a la carrera. Según algunas fuentes, una encuesta informal del Consejo de Seguridad situaba a Rebeca Grynspan, exvicepresidenta de Costa Rica, como la favorita por un estrecho margen. Aunque Grynspan ha liderado las "encuestas informales", la semana pasada tanto ella como el resto de candidatos recibieron dos o más votos en contra de los cinco miembros permanentes del Consejo -Reino Unido, China, Francia, Rusia y Estados Unidos-, que son los que tienen la última palabra. Los miembros del Consejo están negociando si celebrar otra votación el viernes o en una fecha posterior. Nusseibeh, de 48 años, afirmó que varios países se pusieron en contacto con ella durante la última Asamblea General de la ONU para que presentara su candidatura. Los diplomáticos en Nueva York afirman que es respetada por su competencia como gestora. "Hoy en día se reconoce que necesitamos a alguien que aporte un cambio generacional a la organización", afirmó. Su permanencia en la ONU coincidió con el estallido de la guerra de Gaza en 2023, cuando logró que se aprobara la Resolución 2720, allanando el camino para la entrega de ayuda humanitaria. Nusseibeh explicó que consiguió el apoyo a la resolución organizando una visita de los miembros del Consejo al paso fronterizo de Rafá para que pudieran comprobar por sí mismos la situación en terreno, y describió la iniciativa como parte de la "diplomacia emprendedora y creativa" que caracteriza su enfoque. Una victoria de Nusseibeh la convertiría en la segunda secretaria general de la ONU procedente de Oriente Medio, tras el egipcio Boutros Boutros-Ghali. "Vengo de un país que es más joven que las Naciones Unidas, pero nuestra región se ha enfrentado a graves desafíos", afirmó. También se convertiría en la primera mujer en dirigir la ONU, aunque Nusseibeh señaló que no se presentaba por su género. "Creo que sería estupendo que el próximo secretario general fuera una mujer, pero no me presento por ser mujer; me presento porque soy obstinadamente optimista sobre el futuro de las Naciones Unidas y creo que necesitamos a alguien que sea incansable en la búsqueda de la diplomacia para abrir puertas".

item.title: Mattel adds top shareholder EdgePoint Investment's executive to board
item.description: Mattel said on Wednesday it has added a top executive of its largest shareholder, EdgePoint Investment Group, to its board of directors as the toymaker grapples with weak performance and leadership upheaval.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mattel (MAT.O) said on Wednesday it has added a top executive of its largest shareholder, EdgePoint Investment Group, to its board of directors as the toymaker grapples with weak performance and leadership upheaval. The company has faced pressure from some investors asking the company to consider a sale this year as it battles choppy sales and higher input costs. The Barbie maker appointed EdgePoint partner Lee Matheson to its board, effective immediately. EdgePoint owns about 18% of Mattel.

Today's Talking Points: Anthropic AI leader [USN:L4N4661JI TEXT:"Anthropic"] posted a whopping $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of this year. That was up significantly from a $13 billion loss a year earlier, largely due to a $72 billion accounting charge. The net loss is almost double the $42 billion loss reported for calendar year 2025. Revenue in the first six months of the year was just over $16 billion. Are these figures bullish or bearish? Depends which camp you're in. The headline loss is alarming, but it was mainly due to a one-off charge. Revenue is low and growth is slowing, but exclude the accounting charge and break-even doesn't look quite so far away. However, are the numbers and trends those of a company eyeing a $1.5-$2 trillion IPO valuation? Sub subprime Is the US housing market frozen? It's certainly seizing up, which is traditionally a major red flag for the wider economy. [USN:L1N4650NQ TEXT:"Pending home sales"] in September plunged to the lowest since records began a quarter of a century ago, and [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"housing starts"] fell 5.2% in the month to their lowest since the pandemic. US homebuilder sentiment, meanwhile, has plunged to the lowest level in nearly 14-1/2 years. Rising Fed interest rates, stubbornly high home prices, and mortgage rates the highest in three years at 7.50% are all factors. But it is remarkable that activity now is even weaker than it was at the heights — or depths? — of the 2008 US housing market crash and its aftermath, and the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020. Given the importance of housing and related services to the US economy, growth could suffer. Pounding the beat UK finance minister John Healey delivers his first budget next week. To say he faces a few challenges would be an understatement. [USN:L8N4661Q9 TEXT:"Figures this week"] show government borrowing in September rose more than expected again, and public debt surpassed the psychologically key £3 trillion mark. Part of the reason why borrowing last month rose so much was debt interest payments — bond yields are the highest in decades, and with the debt pile growing, it's a difficult cycle to get out of. He has little wiggle room next week. Bad news for sterling, right? Not necessarily. The latest [USN:L8N4661GS TEXT:"inflation"] and [USN:L8N4650JW TEXT:"wage growth"] data have cemented market expectations for a rate hike on November 5. item.title: Bank of America names Jim Fitterling and Bill Thomas to board of directors
item.description: Bank of America announced two new board members on Wednesday, appointing Jim Fitterling, 65, and Bill Thomas, 58, effective immediately.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of America (BAC.N) announced two new board members on Wednesday, appointing Jim Fitterling, 65, and Bill Thomas, 58, effective immediately. Both were previously CEOs of large companies: Fitterling led Dow (DOW.N) , where he is still executive chairman, and Thomas has been KPMG's chairman and CEO. “We are pleased to welcome two seasoned CEOs," said Bank of America's Chair and CEO Brian Moynihan. Bank of America's lead independent director, Lionel Nowell III, said both members would help strengthen oversight of the bank's long-term strategy. The two executives will replace former board members who had retired earlier this year after reaching the retirement age of 75, Pierre de Weck and Linda Hudson.

item.title: Papa Leão não precisará de mais tratamento contra o câncer, dizem médicos
item.description: O Papa Leão não precisará de mais nenhum tratamento após ter sido submetido a uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão na semana passada, informaram seus médicos nesta quarta-feira, indicando que o tumor não havia se espalhado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Papa Leão não precisará de mais nenhum tratamento após ter sido submetido a uma cirurgia de câncer de pulmão na semana passada, informaram seus médicos nesta quarta-feira, indicando que o tumor não havia se espalhado. O anúncio foi feito em um momento em que ainda não estava claro se o papa, nascido nos Estados Unidos, seguiria adiante com a viagem planejada ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru, marcada para os dias 6 a 17 de novembro. O pontífice, de 71 anos, passou por uma cirurgia em 13 de outubro para a remoção do lobo inferior do pulmão direito e foi diagnosticado com adenocarcinoma pulmonar, a forma mais comum de câncer de pulmão. Exames histológicos finais e análises de biologia molecular do tecido removido confirmaram o diagnóstico, com a doença permanecendo localizada, afirmaram os médicos em comunicado divulgado pelo Vaticano. “Uma avaliação oncológica posterior confirmou que não é necessária nenhuma terapia adicional”, afirmaram o cirurgião-chefe do papa, Stefano Margaritora, e seu médico pessoal, Luigi Carbone. Leão recebeu alta do hospital no sábado e está retomando gradualmente suas atividades normais. Nesta quarta-feira, ele voltou à Praça de São Pedro para sua audiência semanal com os peregrinos. Margaritora afirmou na semana passada que não havia “nenhuma razão clínica” que impedisse o papa de viajar para a América do Sul, mas o secretário de Estado do Vaticano indicou que o pontífice talvez precise ajustar o ritmo de sua agenda para facilitar sua recuperação.

item.title: Tesla reporta flujo de caja positivo gracias a gastos en IA menores a lo previsto
item.description: Tesla anunció el miércoles un inesperado flujo de caja positivo del tercer trimestre, ya que gastó mucho menos de lo que esperaban los analistas en sus proyectos de inteligencia artificial y robótica, en un momento en el que el fabricante de vehículos eléctricos está considerando una fusión con SpaceX , la firma de cohetes de su presidente ejecutivo, Elon Musk.
item.dc:creator: Akash Sriram, Abhirup Roy
item.content:encoded: Tesla anunció el miércoles un inesperado flujo de caja positivo del tercer trimestre, ya que gastó mucho menos de lo que esperaban los analistas en sus proyectos de inteligencia artificial y robótica, en un momento en el que el fabricante de vehículos eléctricos está considerando una fusión con SpaceX (SPCX.O) , la firma de cohetes de su presidente ejecutivo, Elon Musk. Las acciones de Tesla (TSLA.O) subían más de un 1,7% en las operaciones tras el cierre de la sesión regular. El gasto de capital en el tercer trimestre se situó en 4.730 millones de dólares, frente a la previsión de unos 7.500 millones, lo que contrasta con los 5.790 millones del segundo trimestre y se compara con los 2.250 millones del año anterior. El flujo de caja libre en el trimestre de septiembre se situó en 1.530 millones de dólares, frente a la previsión de que quemara 4.920 millones de dólares de efectivo. La empresa también superó las estimaciones de Wall Street en cuanto a los ingresos del tercer trimestre, ya que el repunte en las entregas de vehículos, impulsadas por los altos precios de la gasolina, y el crecimiento de su unidad de almacenamiento de energía impulsaron las ventas. Musk había dicho el martes que una fusión entre Tesla y SpaceX era una "buena idea" y que las empresas habían creado comités especiales para debatir un acuerdo. El fabricante de automóviles de Austin, en Texas, registró ingresos de 28.050 millones de dólares en el trimestre que finalizó el 30 de septiembre, frente a la estimación promedio de los analistas de 27.880 millones de dólares, según datos recopilados por LSEG. Tesla entregó 486.532 vehículos en el tercer trimestre, superando las expectativas de Wall Street, que se situaban en torno a los 461.100 vehículos. Las entregas descendieron aproximadamente un 2% respecto del año anterior. Su negocio principal de automoción sigue bajo la lupa, ya que sus rivales lanzan modelos más nuevos y, a menudo, más baratos, mientras que Tesla se apoya en gran medida en los ya veteranos Model 3 y Model Y. La compañía ha dicho que superó los 10 millones de vehículos entregados y que el Model Y va camino de convertirse en el vehículo más vendido del mundo este año.

item.title: CV e PCC não declararam apoio a Lula no 2º turno, dizem órgãos competentes
item.description: As facções criminosas Comando Vermelho (CV) e Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) não manifestaram apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno das eleições, que ocorre no próximo domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: As facções criminosas Comando Vermelho (CV) e Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) não manifestaram apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) no segundo turno das eleições, que ocorre no próximo domingo. “PCC e CV declaram apoio a Lula no 2º turno”, anunciam postagens no Facebook. As publicações reaproveitam um post da Jovem Pan divulgado no Facebook no último dia 7, cujo texto original é “PSTU e PCB declaram apoio a Lula no 2º turno”. Não há registros de que a emissora ou qualquer outro veículo de imprensa tenha noticiado a suposta adesão das facções à candidatura do presidente. À Reuters, a Procuradoria-Geral Eleitoral (PGE) disse que não identificou “nenhuma representação que mencione que lideranças do PCC, do CV ou de outra organização criminosa teriam declarado apoio a qualquer candidatura”. Segundo o órgão, há ao menos um caso relacionado ao tema, no qual um cidadão questiona a divulgação de “notícias falsas” que vinculam tais grupos ao petista. O Ministério Público do Rio de Janeiro (MPRJ), Estado onde surgiu o CV, disse que não encontrou informações sobre pronunciamentos de lideranças de organizações criminosas em apoio a candidatos. O Ministério Público de São Paulo (MPSP), Estado berço do PCC, não havia enviado uma resposta até a publicação desta checagem. No pleito deste ano, o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) derrubou propagandas que associavam Lula a facções, além de peças que indicavam uma ligação de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), adversário do petista no segundo turno, com criminosos. Na campanha eleitoral de 2022, a Reuters desmentiu posts que diziam que Lula havia usado um boné em alusão ao crime organizado -- mas que na verdade trazia a abreviação de “complexo” -- e que afirmavam que ele tinha declarado ter pago o PCC , quando na realidade se referiu ao Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC). VEREDICTO Falso. Órgãos do Ministério Público negaram que facções criminosas tenham declarado apoio a Lula no segundo turno das eleições de 2026. item.title: EUA ordenam que diplomatas deixem Arábia Saudita em meio a ataques dos houthis
item.description: O Departamento de Estado dos Estados Unidos ordenou que alguns diplomatas e seus familiares deixassem suas missões na Arábia Saudita e planeja retirar familiares de várias outras missões norte-americanas no Golfo Pérsico, informaram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Departamento de Estado dos Estados Unidos ordenou que alguns diplomatas e seus familiares deixassem suas missões na Arábia Saudita e planeja retirar familiares de várias outras missões norte-americanas no Golfo Pérsico, informaram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters. O porta-voz do Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, afirmou em uma postagem no X que o departamento ordenou a saída de “funcionários não essenciais do governo dos EUA e seus familiares apenas na Arábia Saudita”, em meio aos ataques dos houthis — alinhados ao Irã — no Iêmen contra alvos civis no país. Washington havia enviado de volta alguns membros do corpo diplomático à região nos últimos meses, depois que muitos haviam sido retirados quando Teerã lançou ataques de retaliação contra instalações norte-americanas após o início da guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã, no final de fevereiro. “Os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, têm se envolvido cada vez mais em hostilidades contra a Arábia Saudita, incluindo ataques a aeroportos civis e outras infraestruturas críticas, resultando em vítimas civis e graves interrupções nas viagens”, disse Pigott. Quatro autoridades norte-americanas disseram à Reuters que as missões dos EUA em outros países do Golfo Pérsico também estariam ordenando que familiares deixassem o local. Pigott não se pronunciou sobre mudanças em outras missões fora da Arábia Saudita. A embaixada dos EUA em Riad emitiu um alerta de segurança nesta quarta-feira sobre possíveis novos ataques dos houthis à Arábia Saudita, após recentes ataques mortais, incluindo um ao aeroporto de Riad.

item.title: Colheita nos EUA e negociações sobre Ucrânia pressionam grãos em Chicago
item.description: Os contratos futuros do trigo e do milho negociados na bolsa de Chicago caíram para mínimas de três meses nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o avanço da colheita nos EUA, os novos esforços diplomáticos para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia e as vendas técnicas pesaram sobre os preços.
item.dc:creator: Renee Hickman
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do trigo e do milho negociados na bolsa de Chicago caíram para mínimas de três meses nesta quarta-feira, à medida que o avanço da colheita nos EUA, os novos esforços diplomáticos para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia e as vendas técnicas pesaram sobre os preços. O contrato de trigo mais negociado fechou em queda de 15 centavos, a US$6,2825 o bushel. O contrato de soja mais ativo recuou 3 centavos, para US$12,4525. O milho encerrou em alta de 1,25 centavo, para US$ 4,63-1/4 o bushel, após cair no início do pregão. Novas negociações entre os EUA e a Rússia para pôr fim à guerra da Rússia contra a Ucrânia pressionaram os preços dos grãos, afirmou Arlan Suderman, economista-chefe de commodities da StoneX. As discussões aumentaram as expectativas de uma possível redução da tensão, o que poderia reativar os embarques de grãos por essa importante rota marítima. O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, recebeu o enviado dos EUA, Steve Witkoff, na quarta-feira, um dia após Witkoff se reunir com o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, na Noruega. O avanço da colheita nos EUA incentivou os fundos de investimento a liquidar posições compradas acumuladas nos últimos meses, quando os mercados de grãos atingiram máximas não vistas há vários anos. A previsão de tempo seco em todo o Meio-Oeste nesta semana deve permitir que os agricultores norte-americanos acelerem a colheita do que o governo projeta ser grandes safras de milho e soja. As chuvas da semana passada deixaram o andamento da colheita abaixo das expectativas do mercado. A oferta da safra ofuscou a renovada demanda chinesa por soja dos EUA, já que o Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA confirmou mais compras na terça-feira. No Brasil, os agricultores haviam plantado 26% da área projetada para a safra de soja 2026/27 até a última quinta-feira, informou na segunda-feira a consultoria do agronegócio AgRural.

item.title: New Zealand's Fisher & Paykel Healthcare hit by cyber breach
item.description: Medical device maker Fisher & Paykel Healthcare on Thursday said it was made aware of unauthorized and unlawful access to a subset of company files and two employee email accounts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Medical device maker Fisher & Paykel Healthcare (FPH.NZ) on Thursday said it was made aware of unauthorized and unlawful access to a subset of company files and two employee email accounts. Here are the details: Some of the files accessed contained personally identifiable information and the company is in the process of informing the people affected. It said it has notified the relevant authorities "There is no evidence that the unlawful activity compromised the company's system that maintains patient data," the New Zealand company said. Fisher & Paykel, which makes devices to treat obstructive sleep apnea, said there has been no impact on the company's products, manufacturing operations or supply chain The company said it believes the incident is contained, with no evidence of ransomware or malware identified, and that it expects no material financial impact New Zealand's National Cyber Security Centre did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the issue The incident comes a day after government websites in Europe and elsewhere [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"went offline"], when the disclosure of critical flaws in a widely used programming language sent site operators worldwide scrambling to protect their systems

item.title: Meta emitirá nuevas acciones para financiar el gasto en inteligencia artificial
item.description: Meta elevó el miércoles el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual y anunció que emitiría nuevas acciones sin derecho a voto para ayudar a financiar su costosa expansión en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) elevó el miércoles el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual y anunció que emitiría nuevas acciones sin derecho a voto para ayudar a financiar su costosa expansión en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial. Las acciones de la empresa subían alrededor de un 4% en la negociación tras el cierre de la sesión regular. Meta ha estado invirtiendo grandes cantidades de dinero en chips y centros de datos para competir de forma más agresiva con OpenAI y Anthropic, lo que ha mermado su flujo de caja libre, que históricamente ha sido muy sólido. Las nuevas acciones podrían permitir a la empresa financiar adquisiciones y atraer a los mejores talentos sin diluir el control de voto del presidente ejecutivo, Mark Zuckerberg, cuando la carrera por la IA en Silicon Valley se vuelve más intensa. La empresa matriz de Facebook e Instagram ha indicado que ahora prevé que el gasto de capital se sitúe entre 135.000 millones y 145.000 millones de dólares este año, frente a la previsión anterior de entre 130.000 millones y 145.000 millones de dólares. La empresa tuvo unos ingresos de 64.600 millones de dólares en el trimestre finalizado el 30 de septiembre, más que las previsiones de Wall Street de 63.370 millones de dólares, según datos recopilados por LSEG. Además, prevé unos ingresos para el cuarto trimestre también superiores a las estimaciones. "Nuestras inversiones están dando frutos, el negocio principal es sólido y estamos observando un impulso generalizado", dijo Zuckerberg en un comunicado. La rápida popularidad de su agente de IA orientado al consumidor, Muse, y el lanzamiento de una nueva y competitiva serie de modelos de IA han ayudado a Meta a justificar las inversiones, aunque algunas empresas están restringiendo el acceso al agente por motivos de seguridad. Los retos legales también se están acumulando, incluida una multa de 25.000 millones de dólares impuesta por un juez de Nuevo México después de que un jurado determinó que Meta había engañado a los residentes del estado sobre cómo compartía los datos de los usuarios con terceros y aplicaba las políticas sobre discurso de odio y desinformación. Meta reportó un beneficio por acción diluido de 3,83 dólares en el trimestre, una cifra que habría sido de 7,40 dólares de no ser por un cargo de 9.890 millones de dólares relacionado con un acuerdo judicial alcanzado en agosto. El acuerdo eliminó un importante obstáculo regulatorio que había lastrado las acciones de Meta y permitió a la empresa evitar un juicio potencialmente largo que podría haber sacado a la luz más documentos internos sobre su trato a los usuarios jóvenes. Casi todos los ingresos de Meta proceden de la publicidad: Reels compite con TikTok y YouTube Shorts por el dominio del mercado de los videos cortos, y Threads se enfrenta a X, de Elon Musk, mientras que su IA perfecciona la segmentación publicitaria y las recomendaciones para impulsar la participación de los usuarios.

item.title: Analog chipmaker Texas Instruments sees quarterly sales above estimates
item.description: Texas Instruments forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign of recovery in industrial chip demand and growing momentum for its AI data-center chips.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Texas Instruments (TXN.O) forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, a sign of recovery in industrial chip demand and growing momentum for its AI data-center chips. Unlike Nvidia (NVDA.O) , which makes high-performance AI processors, Dallas, Texas-based TI produces analog chips that manage power and convert real-world inputs such as sound, light and temperature into digital signals for other semiconductors to process The analog chipmaker expects fourth-quarter revenue between $5.80 billion and $6.30 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $5.73 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Quarterly profit is expected to be between $2.45 and $2.79 per share Texas Instruments, one of the first major chipmakers to post quarterly results, is widely considered a bellwether for the broader electronics and semiconductor industries Its analog and embedded chips are used in smartphones, laptops, cars as well as factory equipment TI's third-quarter revenue rose 28% to $6.06 billion from the same period last year, topping estimates of $5.92 billion. Quarterly profit rose 77% to $2.62 per share. "Our cash flow from operations of $9.9 billion for the trailing 12 months again underscored the strength of our business model, the quality of our product portfolio and the benefit of 300mm production," CEO Haviv Ilan said

item.title: Venezuela to attract investors after elections, Branson says
item.description: British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British billionaire and Virgin Group owner Richard Branson said on Wednesday that Venezuela will attract more foreign investors once the country holds elections, as the South American nation seeks to boost capital inflows in sectors like oil and gas. Venezuela's Interim President Delcy Rodriguez and US President Donald Trump have both said Venezuela [USN:L1N45G0XU TEXT:"will hold elections"] but have not provided a timeline. The country will attract more investment once it holds elections, Branson said, but for now investors are waiting for more legal certainty. "A lot obviously depends on the next 18 months," Branson said, adding that Venezuela will have a "tremendous opportunity" once elections occur and rule of law is established. He did not elaborate on a possible timeline. "Investment needs certainty. It needs a proper judicial process and legal security. It needs transparency," Branson said. "And an access to capital needs to know the capital is secure." Branson spoke at an event in Venezuela with entrepreneurs and investment fund representatives, which was also attended by Venezuelan Foreign Minister Felix Plasencia and Industry Minister Luis Villegas. Rodriguez, who has Washington's backing, assumed power after President Nicolas Maduro's capture in a US operation in January. She promised elections in a [USN:L1N45F13J TEXT:"UN speech"] in September. Despite legal reforms approved by Venezuela's parliament to boost investment, global investors remain hesitant due to distrust of the legal system and political uncertainty, particularly in non-energy sectors.

item.title: Lawmakers say US briefing showed Russia targeting Democrats with misinformation
item.description: The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Landay
item.content:encoded: The top Democratic lawmakers on the congressional intelligence committees on Wednesday said they received an intelligence briefing that Russia has been waging a misinformation campaign against Democrats running in next month's [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. The comments by Senator Mark Warner and Representative Jim Himes come as Republican President Donald Trump has in recent weeks eased economic sanctions on Russia and increased pressure on Ukraine to end its fight against Russian forces. Warner and Himes told reporters they were limited in revealing what they had learned in an election security briefing that they had requested from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton because it was classified. But, they said, Russia was waging the same kind of online misinformation campaign that the US intelligence community had tracked in US elections in 2016, 2020, and 2024. "And the state of play, I would argue, is that, you know, Russia, similar to prior occasions, is going after Democrats," Warner said. He noted news reports that Democrat James Talarico, who is running for the US Senate in Texas, and Senator Jon Ossoff, who is seeking re-election in Georgia, "in particular are being dinged" by fake advertisements created with AI. The White House and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Russian embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Moscow in the past has denied meddling in US elections. Himes said the pair could not provide details of the misinformation spread by Russia because the material was classified. But he added that Moscow's conduct has been "the same old, same old." "The Russians are kind of throwing everything out there," said Himes. "Chaos, you know, don't trust your voting machines." He added there was "no reason to believe" that China has not been conducting "extremely targeted" efforts as it has done in the past to influence voters. The Chinese embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Beijing has previously denied interfering in US elections. Recent Reuters/Ipsos polling has shown Democrats leading Republicans on the generic congressional ballot by high single digits to low double digits nationally, bolstering Democratic hopes of regaining control of the House of Representatives and possibly the Senate. The lawmakers said they were concerned that Trump could pursue efforts to contest election results, including by claiming foreign hacking of voting infrastructure. Himes emphasized that there was no evidence that any country could penetrate US election systems and change results. "Nothing out there suggests that there is even the capability or the intent to do interference, whereas there is a pretty robust influence environment," said Himes.

item.title: Austrian and Swiss women freed after 18 months in Niger reach Benghazi, sources say
item.description: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday. [USN:L1N4530IW TEXT:"The Austrian"], identified by Austrian authorities as Eva G, who is in her 70s, was kidnapped in the desert town of Agadez in central Niger in January 2025. Little information has been released about which group was holding her or what demands they may have made. She had been living in Niger for years. The Swiss woman was taken hostage in April 2025. The Swiss Foreign Ministry did not previously name the hostage. The two officials said the women would be handed over to authorities in their respective countries after the necessary procedures were completed. They added that the operation was overseen by Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of Libya's armed forces. Niger, like its neighbours Mali and Burkina Faso, is battling a jihadist insurgency linked to al Qaeda and Islamic State that spun out of a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali in 2012. The fighting has killed thousands and displaced millions across West Africa's central Sahel region over the past decade. Kidnappings appeared to intensify in Niger last year.

item.title: Estatal egípcia volta ao mercado e adquire 5 cargas de trigo, dizem operadores
item.description: A Future of Egypt, empresa estatal egípcia responsável pela compra de grãos, adquiriu cerca de cinco cargas de trigo nesta semana, em uma de suas primeiras importações conhecidas nos últimos meses, segundo informaram seis fontes do setor à Reuters, à medida que as interrupções nas exportações do Mar Negro reduzem a oferta.
item.dc:creator: Sarah Safty, Olga Popova, Michael Hogan
item.content:encoded: A Future of Egypt, empresa estatal egípcia responsável pela compra de grãos, adquiriu cerca de cinco cargas de trigo nesta semana, em uma de suas primeiras importações conhecidas nos últimos meses, segundo informaram seis fontes do setor à Reuters, à medida que as interrupções nas exportações do Mar Negro reduzem a oferta. O trigo foi adquirido por meio de negociações privadas, e não por licitação. A origem das cargas ainda não está clara, mas quatro operadores afirmaram que elas devem vir da Europa, incluindo França e Romênia. A compra marca um retorno ao mercado para a empresa estatal egípcia, que permaneceu praticamente à margem nos últimos meses em meio às interrupções no abastecimento causadas pelo conflito entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia. O Egito comprou uma quantidade recorde de trigo de produtores locais este ano, enquanto as autoridades afirmaram que as reservas estratégicas eram suficientes para cobrir as necessidades domésticas por vários meses. A Rússia e a Ucrânia atenderam mais de 82% das importações de trigo do Egito no primeiro semestre de 2026. Contudo, ataques recíprocos a portos, terminais de exportação e navios comerciais forçaram os transportadores a adiar ou cancelar cargas, levando os importadores a buscar fontes alternativas de abastecimento. A interrupção também forçou alguns exportadores russos a redirecionar cargas por portos do Báltico, embora os comerciantes afirmem que as rotas alternativas tenham capacidade muito menor do que a do Mar Negro. Os comerciantes afirmaram que o comprador estatal tem se mostrado mais ativo recentemente na solicitação de indicações de preços e ofertas.

item.title: El Salvador dice bandas de Haití tienen como rehenes a cuatro connacionales, anuncia misión rescate
item.description: El presidente Nayib Bukele afirmó el miércoles que bandas haitianas tenían como rehenes a cuatro salvadoreños miembros de una fuerza de seguridad internacional respaldada por la ONU, y que había puesto en marcha una operación militar para rescatarlos sanos y salvos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente Nayib Bukele afirmó el miércoles que bandas haitianas tenían como rehenes a cuatro salvadoreños miembros de una fuerza de seguridad internacional respaldada por la ONU, y que había puesto en marcha una operación militar para rescatarlos sanos y salvos. El ejército de El Salvador y la Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas, encargada de ayudar a la policía haitiana a combatir a las poderosas pandillas, anunciaron a principios de la semana que estaban trabajando para rescatar a los salvadoreños desaparecidos, pero señalaron que los intensos combates en la zona habían limitado el acceso. "Hoy hemos lanzado una operación militar para rescatarlos", afirmó Bukele en su cuenta de X, sin dar más detalles sobre la operación ni identificar al grupo que mantiene a los salvadoreños como rehenes. La Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Los cuatro salvadoreños desaparecieron el domingo tras saltar de un [USN:L6N46512U TEXT:"vehículo blindado en llamas"] que fue emboscado por bandas armadas en las afueras de la capital, cuando regresaban de un mercado a su base, informaron fuentes de seguridad. Las bandas haitianas han consolidado su influencia sobre la capital y se han expandido a las regiones circundantes en los últimos años, aprovechando un vacío político de larga data, la extorsión generalizada y un flujo de armas ilegales procedentes en gran parte de Estados Unidos. Varios países, entre ellos Chad y Sri Lanka, han desplegado soldados como parte de la Fuerza de Represión de Pandillas, que, tras un año de mandato, apenas ha alcanzado algo más de un tercio de su tamaño previsto y ha tenido un impacto limitado en la seguridad de Haití. "Señores, los secuestrados no son combatientes. Son técnicos en el ámbito de la aviación que forman parte de nuestra misión en Haití, en el marco de una misión internacional", dijo Bukele. "Nuestra misión solo cuenta con pilotos y personal técnico, cuyo trabajo principal es realizar evacuaciones médicas y salvar vidas, no hacer la guerra", agregó.

item.title: Luka Doncic makes promise to Lakers fans: 'No excuses; No nights off'
item.description: Luka Doncic is the undisputed face of the Los Angeles Lakers now, following LeBron James' departure, and promised the fans that the team is ready to make a serious charge to an NBA title.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Luka Doncic is the undisputed face of the Los Angeles Lakers now, following LeBron James' departure, and promised the fans that the team is ready to make a serious charge to an NBA title. In a full-page ad that ran in the Los Angeles Times, Doncic wrote that "the run for a championship" begins Wednesday and that the team's fans deserve a level of play that matches the intensity of its supporters. "From the moment I arrived in LA, you welcomed me with open arms. That is something I will never forget," Doncic wrote. "So here is my promise to you: we are going to give you everything we have, every single night. No excuses. No nights off." In turn, the six-time All-Star asked fans to come along for the ride. "You are the best fans in the world, and we are going to need you," he wrote. "Every game, bring it with us." The Lakers were 53-29 last season and had the fourth-best record in the Western Conference. But Doncic, a six-time All-NBA first team selection, missed the last two weeks of the regular season and the playoffs with a hamstring injury, as Los Angeles was eliminated in the second round. James departed in the offseason and signed with the Philadelphia 76ers. It left the Lakers to retool the roster with the likes of new additions Walker Kessler, Sandro Mamukelashvili, Collin Sexton and Ziaire Williams, among others. The Lakers last won the NBA title in the pandemic season of 2020 and have advanced past the first round of the playoffs twice in the past six seasons. Doncic hopes to return the Lakers to their former glory that includes 17 NBA championships. "Each of us understands what it means to put on this purple and gold jersey and follow the players who wore it before us," Doncic wrote. "It means so much because of the passion and dedication that generations of you all have shown for this team." The Lakers open the season Wednesday night at home against the Golden State Warriors. According to DraftKings, as of Wednesday afternoon, Los Angeles had the 14th-best odds of winning the title at +4000. --Field Level Media

item.title: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield (thumb) full participant at practice
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield was a full participant at practice Wednesday, marking the first time he has gone through a full midweek workout since dislocating his right thumb during a Week 3 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield was a full participant at practice Wednesday, marking the first time he has gone through a full midweek workout since dislocating his right thumb during a Week 3 loss to the Minnesota Vikings. "Once he got warmed up, I thought he was looking pretty good as practice went on," Bucs coach Todd Bowles said. "We'll continue to monitor and see how he goes through the week." It remains unclear if Mayfield will be available to play when Tampa Bay (1-5) visits the Carolina Panthers (3-2) on Sunday, with Bowles saying, "It was encouraging to see him do the things we wanted him to do." Mayfield felt comfortable participating with a glove on his right hand, which is something the QB has done in the past, according to Bowles. "We'll see how he feels, first, then we'll go through that as we get through tomorrow and Friday," Bowles said. "We've got to see how he comes out of it, after a day, how the thumb responds." In Mayfield's absence, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels has started the last three games, going 1-2. Including his Week 3 appearance off the bench, Daniels has completed 61.2% of his passes for 501 yards, three touchdowns and five interceptions. Bowles said Mayfield and Daniels were splitting reps on Wednesday. "Each got to get mental reps sometimes, some got to get physical reps," Bowles said. "They both understand the game plan and they're both ready to play." --Field Level Media

item.title: Southwest tops quarterly profit estimates on higher fares, fees
item.description: Southwest Airlines posted better-than-expected third-quarter adjusted earnings on Wednesday, driven by higher fares and additional fees, but forecast fourth-quarter profit below expectations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) posted better-than-expected third-quarter adjusted earnings on Wednesday, driven by higher fares and additional fees, but forecast fourth-quarter profit below expectations. Airlines in the US have so far relied on a swathe of fare hikes, checked baggage fees and capacity controls to boost revenues, as they contend with volatile fuel prices that have made it harder for airlines to forecast costs and earnings. The Dallas-based carrier reported an adjusted profit of 66 cents per share in the September quarter, up from 11 cents a year earlier and above Wall Street expectations of 58 cents, according to data compiled by LSEG. Shares of the airline were up 1% in extended trading. However, it slashed its full-year adjusted profit forecast to $2.60 to $2.85 per share, from its earlier range of $3.25 to $4.25 per share. Analysts on average estimate an adjusted profit of $2.85 per share. For the fourth quarter, Southwest expects profit of 55 cents to 80 cents per share, also below estimates of an 82 cents profit. Jet fuel prices have scaled their spring highs in recent months as the Middle East conflict shows no sign of abating. Meanwhile, oil is at a five-month high amid supply fears due to Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure. The spike in crude prices has prompted airlines to scale back year-end and 2027 capacity growth, as they brace for higher-for-longer fuel expenses. Rival Delta (DAL.N) warned that airlines may need to [USN:L4N45U1TW TEXT:"curb flight growth next year"] to sustain higher fees, while United Airlines (UAL.O) has said it expects fuel prices to [USN:L1N4670PX TEXT:"remain elevated throughout 2027"]. Southwest expects fuel prices to average at $4.55 per gallon during the fourth quarter, based on the forward curve as of October 15.

item.title: Germany's SAP lifts 2026 revenue expectations to top of range after backlog beat
item.description: Europe's largest tech company SAP achieved a €10 billion ($11.2 billion) quarterly revenue milestone for the first time on Wednesday, while reporting a 26% rise in current cloud backlog and moving its 2026 revenue expectations to the upper end of its outlook range.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Europe's largest tech company SAP (SAPG.DE) achieved a €10 billion ($11.2 billion) quarterly revenue milestone for the first time on Wednesday, while reporting a 26% rise in current cloud backlog and moving its 2026 revenue expectations to the upper end of its outlook range. Cloud revenue rose 26% to €6.67 billion in the third quarter while non-IFRS operating profit rose 18% to €3.03 billion. SAP's cloud backlog at constant currencies grew 26% to €24.14 billion ($27.11 billion), ahead of the 24% to 25% growth UBS had forecast. SAP's order book is watched as a gauge of enterprise tech spending worldwide as its software suite runs accounting and payroll at many of the world's biggest companies. A miss on the measure in January sent the shares down 15% in a single [USN:L6N3YT0VR TEXT:"day"]. SAP now expects 2026 subscription revenue — access to software customers rent remotely rather than buy and run themselves — toward the top of its €25.8 billion to €26.2 billion forecast, up 23% to 25%. Including the declining classic licence business, it sees revenue of €36.3 to €36.8 billion, up 12% to 13%, at the top of its range. SAP kept its yearly operating profit outlook of €11.8 billion to €12.2 billion at constant currencies. ($1 = 0.8903 euros)

item.title: Justiça nos EUA manda Meta pagar multa de US$25 bilhões
item.description: Um juiz do estado norte-americano do Novo México determinou nesta quarta-feira que a Meta pague US$25 bilhões, depois que a empresa foi condenada por um júri por enganar usuários em um processo relacionado a violação de privacidade de dados.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Um juiz do estado norte-americano do Novo México determinou nesta quarta-feira que a Meta (META.O) pague US$25 bilhões, depois que a empresa foi condenada por um júri por enganar usuários em um processo relacionado a violação de privacidade de dados. O procurador-geral do Novo México, Raúl Torrez, afirmou que se trata de uma das maiores, se não a maior, sentença proferida por um único estado contra a empresa na história dos Estados Unidos. “As irregularidades do Facebook, cometidas ao longo de anos e sistematicamente divulgadas ao público, atingem o cerne das práticas comerciais fundamentais do Facebook”, escreveu o juiz Francis Mathew em sua decisão após o veredicto. Mathew considerou que uma multa de mais de US$219 bilhões era justificada, com base na legislação estadual, mas reduziu o valor para US$25 bilhões. Em comunicado, C.J. Mahoney, diretor jurídico da Meta, afirmou que a empresa está confiante de que vencerá na apelação. “Essa decisão, e a abordagem do procurador-geral em relação a essa ação, tornam praticamente impossível fazer negócios no estado do Novo México”, disse Mahoney. “Em essência, essa ação judicial busca impor um imposto sobre a liberdade de expressão para impor novas regras sobre o que as pessoas podem dizer online.” A empresa já havia afirmado anteriormente que uma multa na casa dos bilhões de dólares corria o risco de violar seus direitos constitucionais ao devido processo legal e à proteção contra multas excessivas. A multa é a maior já aplicada contra a gigante da tecnologia na esteira do escândalo da Cambridge Analytica. Em 2019, a Meta foi condenada a pagar uma multa de US$5 bilhões pela Comissão Federal de Comércio dos EUA (FTC) decorrente do mesmo escândalo. Outros seis estados chegaram a um acordo em suas ações judiciais relacionadas à Cambridge Analytica no valor de US$459,2 milhões, como parte de um acerto multiestatal de US$17,1 bilhões que a Meta firmou em agosto para resolver as alegações dos estados de que as plataformas da empresa haviam prejudicado a saúde mental de adolescentes. AÇÃO DE CINCO ANOS O procurador-geral do Novo México havia processado a Meta em 2021, após revelações de que a Cambridge Analytica havia coletado dados pessoais de até 87 milhões de usuários do Facebook por meio de um aplicativo de terceiros. O estado acusou a Meta de mentir aos usuários do Facebook no Novo México sobre quem tinha acesso aos seus dados, como a empresa lida com discursos de ódio e desinformação publicados na plataforma e outras políticas internas. A empresa sabia que terceiros tinham amplo acesso aos dados pessoais dos usuários e tolerava discursos de ódio ou outros conteúdos prejudiciais quando isso beneficiava seus resultados financeiros, afirmou o estado. A Cambridge Analytica, hoje extinta, trabalhou para a bem-sucedida campanha presidencial de Donald Trump em 2016 e obteve acesso às informações pessoais de milhões de contas do Facebook com o objetivo de traçar perfis de eleitores e direcionar mensagens. A empresa obteve essas informações sem o consentimento dos usuários por meio de um pesquisador que havia recebido permissão do Facebook para implantar um aplicativo em sua rede social. “Já fazia muito tempo que esperávamos responsabilizar as grandes empresas de tecnologia”, disse Torrez a jornalistas após a decisão desta quarta-feira. “Acho que a decisão de hoje representa uma ruptura clara com esse passado e um aviso muito claro para aqueles neste setor e além dele de que pretendemos proteger nosso povo e nossos consumidores.” O analista Gil Luria, chefe de pesquisa tecnológica da D.A. Davidson & Co, considerou a decisão onerosa, mas improvável que tenha impacto no valor da empresa. “A Meta vale quase US$2 trilhões e provavelmente continuará a recorrer desses processos e a prolongá-los”, disse Luria. LONGA BATALHA Especialistas jurídicos e analistas financeiros afirmaram que a penalidade provavelmente enfrentará uma longa batalha na fase de recurso. Em 25 de setembro, os jurados concluíram que 26 das 29 declarações feitas pela empresa e por sua diretoria sobre essas questões eram enganosas. Eles afirmaram que a Meta cometeu mais de 43 milhões de violações das leis de proteção ao consumidor do Novo México, com base no número de usuários do Facebook ou residentes do Novo México que constituíam o público-alvo de cada declaração enganosa. A lei estadual permite uma multa de até US$5.000 por violação e determina que todo o dinheiro seja destinado ao sistema escolar do Novo México, disse Torrez. Em uma audiência realizada em 1º de outubro, Randi McGinn, advogada do Novo México, havia solicitado a Mathew que concedesse ao estado uma indenização entre US$35 bilhões e US$40 bilhões, argumentando que tal decisão seria respaldada pelas garantias constitucionais dos Estados Unidos relativas ao devido processo legal e pelo veredicto do júri. “Este tribunal deve se comunicar com a Meta na única linguagem que ela entende, que é o dinheiro e o valor de suas ações”, disse McGinn. Em documentos judiciais, a Meta defendeu que as multas deveriam ser limitadas a US$3,45 bilhões, argumentando que valores mais altos corriam o risco de afugentar empresas do estado. As provas demonstraram que a Meta não vende dados de usuários e que o Novo México não comprovou que algum consumidor tivesse realmente sido induzido em erro, afirmou a empresa nos documentos judiciais. Daryl Lim, reitor associado da Faculdade de Direito Dickinson da Penn State, disse que, embora a Constituição dos EUA geralmente proteja contra multas excessivas, devido à forma como a lei do Novo México está redigida, o alto valor da multa não significa automaticamente que ela possa ser anulada. SEGUNDO O veredicto desta quarta-feira foi o segundo em seis meses proferido por um júri de Santa Fé em uma ação movida pelo estado do Novo México contra a Meta. No primeiro julgamento, que terminou em março, um júri de Santa Fé concluiu que a Meta induziu os usuários em erro quanto à segurança dos jovens em suas plataformas Facebook, Instagram e WhatsApp e ordenou que a empresa pagasse US$375 milhões em multas civis. Após uma segunda fase desse julgamento, um juiz determinou que a empresa depositasse US$567 milhões em um fundo do Novo México destinado à saúde mental de adolescentes e ordenou que a Meta implemente medidas para proteger os usuários adolescentes do Facebook e do Instagram no estado.

item.title: Anthropic unveils Claude Duet AI agent app
item.description: Anthropic on Thursday unveiled Claude Duet, a standalone AI agent app designed to act as a proactive assistant for professionals and small-business owners, as rivals such as OpenAI and Meta race to develop AI agents that can complete work autonomously on users' behalf.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic on Thursday unveiled Claude Duet, a standalone AI agent app designed to act as a proactive assistant for professionals and small-business owners, as rivals such as OpenAI and Meta (META.O) race to develop AI agents that can complete work autonomously on users' behalf. Duet delivers a daily briefing and handles tasks ranging from scheduling meetings to building financial forecasts and web apps, Anthropic said Available on iOS, Android and claude.ai through a waitlisted research preview, it monitors users' connected apps and surfaces items requiring attention rather than waiting for prompts Duet is built around Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model and is initially available to US subscribers on Pro and Max plans, sharing existing usage limits OpenAI last month launched always-on [USN:L1N45L0VC TEXT:""dots" agents"] that pursue user goals across apps such as Slack and Microsoft Teams (MSFT.O) , while Meta's [USN:L6N45010V TEXT:"Muse AI agent"] drew millions of downloads and fueled investor interest in autonomous AI services Duet integrates with over 6,000 connectors in the Claude Marketplace, including Gmail and Slack, and can make purchases via Stripe's Link digital wallet and Shopify's (SHOP.TO) Shop Pay The AI lab said Claude Duet requires user approval for sensitive actions, while acknowledging the agent can misjudge urgency and remains less effective at personal tasks such as booking tickets

item.title: Long fight over refiner Citgo progresses at US appeals court
item.description: A US Court of Appeals in Philadelphia on Wednesday heard parties involved in a long-running, court-organized auction of the parent company of Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum.
item.dc:creator: Marianna Parraga
item.content:encoded: A US Court of Appeals in Philadelphia on Wednesday heard parties involved in a long-running, court-organized auction of the parent company of Venezuela-owned refiner Citgo Petroleum. Supporters defended a decision in a federal court in Delaware late last year that ordered the sale of the company for $5.9 billion to a hedge fund affiliate, while opponents including Venezuela, some creditors and rival bidders argued that the process was tainted, with the court passing over higher offers. In November, a federal judge in Delaware approved the $5.9 billion [USN:L1N3X00MJ TEXT:"bid"] from an affiliate of Elliott Investment Management for Citgo's parent PDV Holding to pay a group of Venezuela-linked creditors. This triggered the opposition, and the sale has not yet been executed, awaiting approval from the US Treasury Department. An April deadline looms over Elliott's Amber Energy to preserve its offer. The court's selection followed several bidding rounds in a case initiated by miner Crystallex International against Venezuela in 2017 for the expropriation of its assets, which allowed other creditors to join the litigation in pursuit of Citgo's parent as compensation. Opposition parties in January [USN:L1N3YE0H4 TEXT:"asked"] the US Court of Appeals of the Third Circuit to vacate the sale order over an alleged conflict of interest involving firms retained by the court as advisors, procedural "errors" that excluded higher bids and what some of them called the "low" valuation of the assets. The court is expected to make a decision after the hearing. The main arguments discussed this week were: BID PRICE The court's use of a methodology combining price and "[USN:L1N3RR0IH TEXT:"certainty of closure"]," or the likelihood that a bid would ultimately be executed, created controversy among bidders. Some companies including miner Gold Reserve (GRZ.V) chose to submit high-price offers. Others, including Amber Energy, gave weight to transaction agreements they argued would help clear obstacles to execute a sale. The most important was a pact with holders of a defaulted Venezuelan bond who hold a collateral claim over one of Citgo's parents. Some attorneys, including Crystallex's counsel Miguel Estrada, said then-US District Judge Leonard Stark in Delaware "went as far as he could to make (the process) transparent," while lawyer Katherine Wellington representing Citgo's ultimate parent PDVSA said the sale price was so low it "shocked the conscience." ALLEGED CONFLICT OF INTEREST Venezuela, PDVSA and creditors including Gold Reserve alleged that a law firm hired by the court to advise on the auction had a work relationship with units of Elliott while the bidding was in process, which they argue "tainted" the process. The parties tried to [USN:FWN3VR1PR TEXT:"disqualify"] Stark and the court officer who oversaw the auction, Robert Pincus. Pincus has denied the allegations. Stark last year denied the disqualification motion. VALUATION AND PROCESS PDVSA's lawyer said the auction "fundamentally hurts the people of Venezuela at a time when they are rebuilding their economy." The selected bid was about $7 billion lower than a valuation of assets completed by court-advising firm Evercore (EVR.N) and $12 billion below the figure presented by an expert brought by Venezuela to court, she said. Citgo's valuation has increased since last year as strong refining margins have boosted [USN:TUA5KZTD9 TEXT:"profits"]. The company is projecting full-year 2026 earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of some $5.8 billion, and a year-end cash balance of approximately $5.7 billion, it said in August.

item.title: Patriots to be without both starting guards vs. Bears
item.description: The New England Patriots will be without their top two offensive guards and another starter when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New England Patriots will be without their top two offensive guards and another starter when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday. Coach Mike Vrabel said the Patriots (4-2) will be without left guard Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring), right guard Ben Brown (knee) and cornerback Carlton Davis III (neck) against the Bears (4-2). Matt Pryor and Walter Rouse will replace Vera-Tucker and Brown along the offensive line.
